desc:
⚡ Welcome to Electric City!

Grab an e-bike and ride through Electric City, a sunny SoCal town full of beaches, boulevards and open roads.

What Electric City has to offer:

🏍️ Real e-bikes: Ride detailed e-bikes and the KuKirin G4 scooter, with real throttle, wheelies and stunts.

🔧 Upgrades: Swap in better motors, batteries, tyres and brakes at VOLT MOTO, then show off your build.

📱 Your phone: Buy and sell bikes on Flip, find your way with Maps, and earn cash delivering food with GrubRun.

🏁 Race your friends: Start a race and invite anyone nearby. Fastest rider takes the bonus.

🚨 Police chases: Ride too wild and the cops come after you. Can you lose them?

🌴 Electric City: Cruise the coast, find shortcuts, and pull wheelies down the main strip.

Ride. Build. Flip. Repeat. ⚡
